title: card.created
description: Creates one card of a note. Schedule (cache) columns are never carried; a new card is state 'new'. OPS.md#cardcreated

id.description: Id of the new card. Equals the envelope's entity_id.

note_id.description: Parent note; must exist (may be tombstoned or merged). Immutable.

kind.description: Card kind, a key of the note type's templates (not validated against them). Immutable.

preset_id.description: Scheduling preset; must exist. Default: the Default preset 00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000010.

suspended.description: Initial value of register 'suspended'. Default false.

buried_until.description: Initial value of register 'buried_until'. Default null.
